projects.title: Hanger Games
projects.description:
Concept Project

- MongoDB/Express/ReactJS/Node
- Uses Yelp's Fusion API and Google Maps API to display nearby restaurant details.
- Token Authentication / User search preferences are saved when logged in.
- 'Choose For Me' button will choose a restaurant for a user to go to.
- Responsive design.

projects.title: WeChef'n
projects.description:
Team Concept Project 

- Django/Python/Postgres
- Chefs can create meals to sell from home.
- Shopping cart feature to allow checkout and saved purchase history for users.
- Meals detail page allows comments from other users and chef tools to upload images using Amazon S3.
